login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue with your business.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Register your business, with or without a physical location.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll send you a link to create a new one.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, we sent you a link to create a new password. Open it in this same browser; it expires in 1 hour.
forgot.linkExpired: The link has expired. Request a new one.
forgot.linkInvalid: The link isn't valid or was already used. Open it in the same browser where you requested it, or request a new one.

update.title: Create a new password
update.subtitle: You'll use it to sign in from now on.
update.label: New password

personal.title: Tell us about yourself
personal.subtitle: We'll use this for your profile. You can't change it after you finish.
personal.birthDateHint: You must be between 16 and 100 years old.

business.title: Your business
business.subtitle: You don't need a physical location to register it.
business.name: Business name
business.establishment: Does your business already have a physical location?
business.yesHint: It will be registered as active.
business.noHint: It will be registered as planning.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
validation.birthDateOutOfRange: You must be between 16 and 100 years old.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.profile_not_found: We couldn't find your profile. Sign out and sign in again.
errors.invalid_full_name: Enter your full name, up to 100 characters.
errors.invalid_birth_date: You must be between 16 and 100 years old.
errors.invalid_business_name: Enter the business name, up to 120 characters.
errors.invalid_industry: Choose an industry from the list.
errors.invalid_status: Tell us whether your business already has a physical location.
errors.business_already_exists: You already have a registered business.

auth.generic: We couldn't complete that. Please try again.
auth.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists.
auth.same_password: Your new password must be different from the old one.

location.entryHint: Find zones for your business with INEGI DENUE data.

form.title: Evaluate a location
form.subtitle: We suggest up to three nearby zones for your business, using INEGI DENUE data.
form.placeHint: Address, neighborhood or place. Pick one of the results.
form.placeRequired: Search for and pick a location.
form.rentHint: In pesos. Shown as your own figure; it is not part of the score.
form.rentInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10,000,000.
form.duration: It usually takes less than a minute.

errors.place_not_found: We couldn't find that place. Try another address or neighborhood.
errors.geocoding_unavailable: The address search is not responding. Try again.
errors.denue_unavailable: We couldn't reach INEGI DENUE. Try again.
errors.insufficient_data: Not enough data: DENUE has {establishments} establishments in the area and {candidates} zones with at least 10. Try another location or a larger radius.
errors.analysis_failed: The analysis could not be completed. Try again.
errors.no_valid_zones: No proposed zone passed validation against DENUE data. Try again or change the radius.

results.title: Recommended zones
results.source: Source: INEGI DENUE, queried on {date}. The DENUE API does not report when its data was last updated.

detail.location: {distance} from your reference · {lat}, {lon} · 300 m zone radius
detail.scoreHint: Computed by the system; compares the zone with the average of the explored area.
detail.whyHint: The agent's explanation, based only on this zone's DENUE data.
detail.name: Name
detail.sourceText: INEGI DENUE. Queried on {date}. The API does not report when its data was last updated.
detail.limitations: A DENUE record does not guarantee that the establishment still operates. DENUE has no foot traffic, safety, transport, population or rent data.
detail.rentEntered: Entered by you. It is not estimated for the zones and is not part of the score.

activity.name: Commercial activity
activity.data: {count} in the zone: {ratio} times the area average.
activity.limit: A DENUE record does not guarantee the business is still open.

competition.name: Direct competition
competition.measures: Businesses in your industry; fewer is better.
competition.data: {count} in the zone: {ratio} times the area average.
competition.none: {count} in the zone; none in the explored area.
competition.limit: Covers the whole industry, not only your business format.

related.name: Related businesses
related.data: {count} in the zone: {ratio} times the area average.
related.none: {count} in the zone; none in the explored area.
related.limit: Which activities count as related is defined by the system.

staff.name: Staff size
staff.data: At least {count} people: {ratio} times the area average.
staff.limit: DENUE gives staff ranges; the lower bound of each range is used.

factors.unavailableIndustry: Your industry has no SCIAN activities defined, so this factor is not computed.
factors.unavailableStaff: DENUE reports no staff data in this area.

compare.title: Compare the zones
compare.subtitle: The same criteria for every zone. Factor points add up to the score.
compare.legend: Each cell: points · times the area average · count in the zone. Source: INEGI DENUE.

chat.title: Ask the agent
chat.hint: It answers only with this evaluation's data.
chat.label: Question
chat.error: The agent could not answer. Try again.
chat.suggestCompetition: Which zone has the least competition?
